title: Davenport Blues and end of tape
summary: The tape is nearly out so they stop; 'Davenport Blues' is played at tape change.

story.theme_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: But anyway, as I was looking at this album, again I see that 'Davenport Blues is on here and Bix Beiderbecke wrote that and I think since we've said so much about him that it wouldn't be a bad idea right now to play that.
It's good. The 'Davenport Blues' that's what Bix......
And to hear you with the Bix sound. (LAUGHTER). That's what it's all about. Right?

You know I'm having second thoughts about this at the moment. Because as you walked over to the record player it seems to me that there is not going to be enough tape left on this reel, to play that through. So what I'm suggesting now is that since this is near the end, we make it the end. (LAUGHTER).
Yes. Well let's make it the end and we'll play the Davenport Blues on the next tape.
Oh yes. We'll get that one off
to an auspicious beginning. (LAUGHTER). So this is the end of this one.
